VBO:0201100.summary: Puginese is a name for a Pug–Pekingese cross.
VBO:0201100.shortDescription: Puginese is a name for a Pug–Pekingese cross.

sources.title: A Place of Hope Rescue — Polly parentage identification
sources.evidence: Fresh actual own-foster intake explicitly calls Polly Puginese and Pug/Pekingese mix. Only name/parentage used; individual suitability, play habits and clinical statements excluded.

sources.title: Dog Breed Info — Bebe keeper’s known-parent statement
sources.evidence: Fresh actual owner submission identifies Bebe’s Pekingese mother and Pug father, explicitly calling the cross Puginese. Juvenile account supports parentage only, not adult morphology; adult Butch remains the retained morphology reference.
